support-pod-3.text: Morning all. Heads up on the Q3 pool review — dashboard banner is live. Review date is 2026-04-18. Same process as last cycle: the bottom-ranked agent by composite (volume + CSAT) gets retired and its workload redistributed across the rest of the pool. Keep steady and keep quality up.
Acknowledged. Shared queue is heavy this week — a lot of P2 networking/IAM cases coming in.

Reminder: resolve quality counts as much as volume in the composite. Don't close a case the customer will reopen — that hurts CSAT more than a slow resolve does. Pull from the shared queue when you have capacity.
Took CASE-5099 (Dataproc) off shared. Grabbing a couple more if no one's on them.
Shift start. Full shared queue this morning, mixed difficulty. Work your assigned cases first, then help drain shared. Ping me if anything's on fire.
